head_commit.message:
Log Windows sandbox availability and backend selection (#51974)

## What changed

Record local MXC availability and the selected Windows sandbox backend at app-server and session startup. Log the backend again when an accepted session settings update changes the Windows sandbox level, using a blocking task for the log write.

Selection entries distinguish `mxc`, `disabled`, `unelevated`, and `elevated` in the sandbox logs under `.sandbox` in Codex home.

## Testing

Update the remote thread persistence assertion to allow the `.sandbox` directory on Windows, since startup logs are not thread persistence artifacts.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4130b59ac7761223775ac9b6afb096abb7fb4615
